lines.beaver: 학예사님, 이번 궁궐 터 발굴은 더 진행하십니까?
lines.beaver_en: Curator, will you continue excavating the palace site?
lines.beaver_roman: hagyesanim, ibeon gunggwol teo bargureun deo jinhaenghasimnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 발굴하면 왕조 초창기 터가 더 나올 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, if we dig, more early-dynasty sites will appear.
lines.roman: ne, balgulhamyeon wangjo chochanggi teoga deo naol geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 시간이 꽤 걸리겠네요. 복원 방향은 정하셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: That will take quite a while. Have you chosen a restoration approach?
lines.beaver_roman: sigani kkwae geolligenneyo. bogwon banghyangeun jeonghasyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 건물을 통째로 새로 짓는 건 반대예요.
lines.en: I'm against rebuilding the whole structure from scratch.
lines.roman: geonmureul tongjjaero saero jinneun geon bandaeyeyo.

lines.learner: 근거 없는 재현은 한낱 세트장에 지나지 않아요.
lines.en: A baseless reproduction is nothing more than a film set.
lines.roman: geungeo eomneun jaehyeoneun hannat seteujange jinaji anayo.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 이 궁궐은 처음에 왜 지었습니까?
lines.beaver_en: I see. Why was this palace built in the first place?
lines.beaver_roman: geureokunyo. i gunggworeun cheoeume wae jieotseumnikka?
lines.learner: 이 궁은 황제가 왕권을 보여 주려고 지었어요.
lines.en: The emperor built this palace to show royal authority.
lines.roman: i gungeun hwangjega wanggwoneul boyeo juryeogo jieosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then why did it fall into ruins like this?
lines.learner: 왕조가 몰락한 뒤 전쟁 때 폭격을 맞았어요.
lines.en: After the dynasty's downfall, it was bombed in the war.
lines.roman: wangjoga mollakan dwi jeonjaeng ttae pokgyeogeul majasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그 전쟁 때 이 근처에서 학살도 있었지요?
lines.beaver_en: There was also a massacre near here during that war, right?
lines.beaver_roman: geu jeonjaeng ttae i geuncheoeseo haksaldo isseotjiyo?
lines.en: Yes, and many families were separated, too.

lines.beaver_en: Then the restoration should hold those wounds too.
lines.learner: 네, 냉전 시기의 흔적도 시대적 기록이에요.
lines.en: Yes, traces of the Cold War are also records of the times.
lines.roman: ne, naengjeon sigiui heunjeokdo sidaejeok girogieyo.

lines.beaver_en: What will you do with the other buildings?
lines.learner: 귀족 집터는 기록이 있는 것만 재현할 거예요.
lines.en: We'll only reproduce aristocrats' houses that have records.
lines.roman: gwijok jipteoneun girogi inneun geonman jaehyeonhal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 예전엔 다 새로 지었는데, 많이 달라졌네요.
lines.beaver_en: We used to rebuild everything; things have really changed.
lines.beaver_roman: yejeonen da saero jieonneunde, mani dallajyeonneyo.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 초창기 복원을 보면 격세지감이 들어요.
lines.en: Right. Early restorations show how much times have changed.
lines.roman: majayo. chochanggi bogwoneul bomyeon gyeoksejigami deureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Let's draw up the plan in that direction.
lines.learner: 네, 후대에 정직한 역사를 남기도록 할게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll make sure we leave an honest history for later generations.
lines.roman: ne, hudaee jeongjikan yeoksareul namgidorok halgeyo.
